spans.s: शोध m. 1. Purification; 2. correction; 3. retaliation; 4. acquittance.
शोधक (II) n. A kind of earth.
शोधन n. 1. Cleaning, purifying; 2. correction; 3. determination; 4. payment, discharge; 5. expiation; 6. excrement, feces; 7. green vitriol; 8. retaliation, punishment; 9. subtraction (in math.).
शोधित a. (f. ता) 1. Cleaned, purified; 2. filtered; 3. corrected; 4. retaliated; 5. paid off, liquidated.
शोधित a. (f. ता) 1. Cleaned, purified; 2. filtered; 3. corrected; 4. retaliated; 5. paid off, liquidated.
शोध्य m. An accused person, one who has to answer a charge.
